items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Yeah, yeah, at Larry Theater, yeah. Wonderful. He was one of them.

ctx.x: Do you remember Red Happy, who used to be a drummer and all that?
Yeah, yeah, at Larry Theater, yeah. Wonderful. He was one of them. Yeah. Zuri, I remember Zuri, but he was at Larry.
Remember him hearing Baby Dodds down here?
